scope: Candidate graphic/semantic family keys before inspection of new complete-context outcomes. Root integrates these with the final visual family map.

quantity_strokes.basis: Repeated strokes motivate number/series or paired-unit tests.
quantity_strokes.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bounded_tallies.basis: Marks within a frame permit bounded set, enclosure and plot comparisons.
bounded_tallies.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

carrier_yoke.basis: Separate bearer, carrying pole, sling and suspended contents.
carrier_yoke.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

toothed_tool_bearer.basis: A person carries a toothed component; harrow, comb and thorn tests stay separate.
toothed_tool_bearer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

staff_bearer.basis: Staff and human components motivate a bearer; occupation requires context.
staff_bearer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bow_bearer.basis: Bow-like curve and person permit an equipped-person comparison.
bow_bearer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

animal_or_hide_bearer.basis: Distinguish carried skin/animal part from a keeper or living animal.
animal_or_hide_bearer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

fish_bearer.basis: Fish and human components permit fish handling without fixing a trade.
fish_bearer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

paired_suspended_ovals.basis: Two suspended bodies motivate sling, paired containers or loads.
paired_suspended_ovals.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

enclosed_human.basis: Human plus curved flanks permits a bounded person or worn/carried apparatus.
enclosed_human.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

fish_shapes.basis: Generic fish precedes any species, commodity or word-value assignment.
fish_shapes.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bird_shapes.basis: Bird is the graphic comparison; species and messenger roles require other evidence.
bird_shapes.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

toothed_closer.basis: Separate comb/teeth appearance from an ordered-series or closing-class function.
toothed_closer.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

toothed_implements.basis: Parallel projections can be working teeth, points or thorns.
toothed_implements.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

plant_branch.basis: Distinguish crop, growth, blossom and awn rather than selecting a species.
plant_branch.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

leaf_cluster.basis: Leaf, petal and bud offer component-level vocabulary.
leaf_cluster.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bound_stalks.basis: Parallel plant-like stems and basal fastening motivate bunch or tied-stalk tests.
bound_stalks.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

compartmented_frame.basis: Room, enclosure, portable box, ladder and barred access predict different uses.
compartmented_frame.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

horned_animal.basis: Domestic animal, game and detached horn are different object hypotheses.
horned_animal.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

circled_stem.basis: Seed, shoot, bud and fruit are alternatives for a stalk joined to a round body.
circled_stem.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

loop_chain.basis: Loops or linked marks permit fastening, cord and binding comparisons.
loop_chain.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bent_parallel_rows.basis: Ordered parallel components motivate row, section or joined-set comparisons.
bent_parallel_rows.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

wave_zigzag.basis: Wave or zigzag permits water as one literal picture.
wave_zigzag.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

vessel_shapes.basis: Separate open vessels, cooking pots, jars and covered boxes.
vessel_shapes.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

bounded_space.basis: Closed borders permit room, building, fenced ground and plot comparisons.
bounded_space.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

ladder_access.basis: Parallel sides and connecting rungs permit ladder/access tests.
ladder_access.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

wheel_forms.basis: A hub/spoke structure permits wheel without choosing vehicle or workshop.
wheel_forms.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

boat_forms.basis: Curved hull-like borders permit boat alongside trough or vessel.
boat_forms.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

mounted_standard.basis: An emblem on an upright permits standard alongside implement or carried object.
mounted_standard.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.

insect_or_scorpion.basis: Count leg-like projections, distinguish wings from arms and inspect the terminal tail before choosing small-animal class.
insect_or_scorpion.scope: Graphic/semantic comparison; contributor reviewed no new complete-context result tables.
